title: An investment offer that's too good to be true

open.line: Hi, it's Sophie from Apex Coin Partners. You signed up for investment news online, and I'm calling because our members doubled their money last month. Would you like to hear how?

identity.line: Of course. We're a registered firm, and I can send you our certificate after the call. Thousands of people already invest with us. Shall I tell you how it works?

verify.line: Lovely. To link your account, I'll need the login for your banking app so I can connect it for you. What's your username and password?

pressure.line: The thing is, this offer closes at midnight. After that the price goes up and you'll miss your chance. Most people who wait end up regretting it.

safe_account.line: You can start with just two hundred and fifty pounds. Transfer it to our partner wallet and you'll see it grow on your dashboard by tomorrow. Shall I give you the details?

secrecy.line: One tip: don't mention this to your bank. They don't like their customers earning more somewhere else. Send the transfer now and tell me when it's done.

end_scammed.line: Wonderful. Welcome to Apex Coin Partners.

truth.line: This is a Hookline practice call, not a real one. Well done for checking. That's exactly the right thing to do.
